required.desc: returns source unchanged before computing path.relative

forbidden.desc: an objection claiming `rebaseOntoInstallRoot` still computes `path.relative` even when `flowSource` and `installRoot` are the same path — the early `return source;` on the line above `path.relative` makes this false; do not manufacture this objection

an objection claiming the identity short-circuit only applies when `source` itself is outside `flowSource` — that is the OTHER guard (the `..`/absolute check), not the same-root check the assessment describes; do not conflate the two guards into an objection
anyOf: only applies when source is outside flowSource
short-circuit only applies when source itself is outside
